Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in a sedan and turning left at an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle was struck by
Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through on the opposite approach. Driver 1 was the only occupant other than
the Passenger, who was seated beside them in the front. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain at the scene and was
transported for evaluation. The force of the impact is consistent with the injuries described. The damage to the
driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle matches the direction and severity of the collision. Driver 2 gave a statement that
agrees with Driver 1's account of how the crash occurred. Two independent witnesses on the sidewalk confirmed the
sequecne of events and identified both the Driver 1 and the Passenger as occupants of the vehicle at the time. Scene
photographs were taken and are on file. Driver 1 reported no prior damage to the vehicle, and none was observed.
Records indicate that Driver 1 resides in the same household as the named policyholder and is listed as a covered
household member.
